subject: science
concept: Using a Punnett square to predict the probability of offspring traits
source_inspiration: adapted from NGSS Life Science Disciplinary Core Ideas (Heredity) — original content, not copied text

exercise.concrete: Student fills in a physical Punnett square grid using allele letter tiles from two parent genotypes
exercise.pictorial: Student matches a completed Punnett square to its correct offspring ratio
exercise.abstract: Student constructs a Punnett square for given parent genotypes and predicts offspring trait probabilities

misconception_flags: fills in the Punnett square boxes incorrectly, mismatching row and column alleles

interest_binding: exercise regenerated using student's stated interest profile
